label: Очка / Ечка
description: A 10-sentence card for the diminutive suffix -очка/-ечка.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: чашечка from чашка. The suffix -ечка turns чашка 'cup' into чашечка 'little cup', adding smallness and a soft, polite tone.
Strategic focus: ложечка from ложка. The suffix -ечка shrinks ложка 'spoon' into ложечка 'little spoon', marking a small teaspoon with a gentle nuance.
Strategic focus: кошечка from кошка. The suffix -ечка turns кошка 'cat' into кошечка 'little cat', conveying smallness and tender affection.
Strategic focus: звёздочка from звезда. The suffix -очка makes звезда 'star' into звёздочка 'little star', adding smallness and a fond, poetic feeling.
Strategic focus: тарелочка from тарелка. The suffix -очка shrinks тарелка 'plate' into тарелочка 'little plate', naming a small dish with a warm tone.
Strategic focus: сумочка from сумка. The suffix -очка turns сумка 'bag' into сумочка 'little bag', marking a small handbag affectionately.
Strategic focus: contrast чашка and чашечка. The plain чашка names a full cup, while чашечка with -ечка signals a small one; the pair shows the suffix adding smallness.
Strategic focus: кошечка from кошка. Here -ечка gives кошечка 'little cat' a doubly small, endearing quality reinforced by 'маленькая'.
Strategic focus: звёздочка from звезда. The suffix -очка turns звезда 'star' into звёздочка 'little star', here naming a small drawn shape with a tender feel.
Strategic focus: сумочка from сумка. The suffix -очка makes сумка 'bag' into сумочка 'little bag', stressing its small, neat size with a pleasant nuance.
